emails.subject: Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund | Pre-IPO & Anchor interest – Anmol Industries Limited
emails.text:
Dear Harish Khajanchi and Anand Rawal,

I am CA Deep Dalal, Fund Manager of Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund. I am writing to you as the Book Running Lead Manager to the proposed IPO of Anmol Industries Limited, whose Draft Red Herring Prospectus dated September 25, 2026 has been filed with SEBI for listing on the Main Board of BSE and NSE.

ABOUT US
Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund is a SEBI-registered Category III Alternative Investment Fund focused on India's primary markets. We invest through Pre-IPO placements, IPO Anchor Investor books, the QIB portion of IPOs and Qualified Institutional Placements (QIPs), working closely with promoters and merchant bankers through the listing journey.

OUR VIEW ON ANMOL INDUSTRIES
Anmol Industries is a branded packaged foods company in India with a focus on aspirational and premium product offerings. We have studied the DRHP closely, and the business and its growth trajectory fit well with our investment focus.

Key financials (restated, ₹ crore unless stated)
                                       FY26       FY25       FY24
Revenue from operations (₹ cr)        2,102      1,641      1,423
Growth (YoY)                          28.1%      15.3%          –
EBITDA (₹ cr)                        287.39      72.61     170.30
EBITDA margin                         13.7%       4.4%      12.0%
Profit after tax (₹ cr)              190.97      38.12     126.21
PAT margin                             9.1%       2.3%       8.9%
Net worth (₹ cr)                     452.78     260.49     222.51
Return on net worth                   42.2%      14.6%      56.7%
Debt / Equity                         0.57x      1.96x          –
Source: restated financial information in the DRHP; EBITDA and ratios computed from it.

HOW WE WOULD LIKE TO PARTICIPATE
  1. Pre-IPO round: Should the Company consider a pre-IPO placement ahead of the RHP, we would be keen to participate.
  2. Anchor Investor portion: As a SEBI-registered Category III AIF, we qualify as a QIB and would like to be considered for the anchor book.
  3. QIB portion: We would also look to participate in the QIB portion of the IPO.

FUND PROFILE
View our fund profile (PDF): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yQX3TH3nmyqzt6rICyliVYFCP1okKqVv/view?usp=sharing (also attached)

I would be grateful if you could introduce us to the promoters of Anmol Industries (Biswanath Choudhary, Dilip Kumar Choudhary and Gobind Ram Choudhary) and keep us informed as the pre-IPO and anchor book discussions progress. A short call at your convenience would be much appreciated.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,

CA Deep Dalal
Fund Manager, Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund
SEBI-registered Category III AIF
Email: fundmanager@parshwanath.in
WhatsApp: +91 83200 52970
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 70690 06298
SEBI Reg. No.: IN/AIF3/25-26/2108

This email is for introduction purposes only and does not constitute an offer, solicitation or commitment to invest. Any investment is subject to the Fund's due diligence, investment committee approval and applicable SEBI regulations. To stop receiving emails from us, reply with “unsubscribe”.
